segments.text: Ok so this is the Open Generative UI page for OpenAI Agents with Angular, and I'm reporting a problem on this page.
So this is the problem, umm, the page only shows the frontend config, the runtime flag that turns it on is never shown.
This is my project, I've implemented the exact code from the doc.
Moving on to the demo. It should render a small dashboard filter in a sandbox, but the agent just writes the buttons as plain HTML in its message.
So basically, the page only gives the frontend part.
Without the runtime open generative UI flag, nothing sandboxed ever renders.
So umm, this one needs fixing, please look into it.
